entitlements.description: Entitlements maps entitlement keys to values ("Up to N datasources").

quotas.description: Quotas are the included allowances ("100 GB included, then $X/GB").

overageUnitPrice.description:
OverageUnitPrice is the lowest non-zero currently-valid pricing-tier
unit price — the "then $X per GB beyond included" figure. Null when the
metric has no overage pricing (UI renders generic copy).

billingMode.description:
BillingMode drives the section layout: metered → PAYG card, plans → tier
grid, choice → PAYG card + optional tier grid.

plans.description:
Plans is the public plan selector, sorted by displayOrder then price.
Empty for metered services.

subscription.description:
Subscription is the org's current subscription on this service, nil when
none (metered services, or choice services on pure PAYG).

expiresAt.description: ExpiresAt is null for grants that never expire.

status.description:
Status is one of active / exhausted / expired / voided — derived
by the backend from amount + consumed + expires_at + voided_at
against wall clock at query time. Voided beats everything; an
exhausted grant overrides expired (the credit was used, not
lost).

voidedAt.description:
VoidedAt is set when the grant was explicitly retired (e.g. the
Phase 5 cascade voids leftover credit when an org is closed).
Null on never-voided grants.

voidedReason.description:
VoidedReason carries the why for voided grants — today always
"org_closed" from the cascade hook, but future use cases (admin
revoke, fraud, etc.) get their own strings.

freeTierUnits.description:
FreeTierUnits is the ceiling derived from $0 pricing tiers; 0
means the metric is billed from unit 1 (no free tier).

freeTierUnlimited.description:
FreeTierUnlimited handles the edge case where a $0 tier has no
upper bound — the metric is always free, no progress bar needed.

metricType.description:
MetricType is "storage" or "usage". Storage metrics don't
extrapolate end-of-month (the MTD average is already a rate);
usage metrics extrapolate linearly. Frontend uses this to label
the projection ("end-of-month forecast" vs "current average").

overflowProjected.description:
OverflowProjected is true when projectedEndOfMonthUnits exceeds
freeTierUnits — the user is on track to incur charges this month.

previousMonthUnits.description:
PreviousMonthUnits is the previous calendar month's final figure
— average for storage, sum for usage. Used for the "Last month"
column so customers can spot trending consumption.

totalActiveRemainingUsdCents.description:
TotalActiveRemainingUSDCents is the sum of remaining USD cents on
every grant that is currently "active" — useful for a headline
"you have $X in credit available" widget on the page header.

get.description: Returns the org's monthly spending cap configuration. Both hardCapCents (block paid usage when crossed) and softCapCents (warn-only) are optional. alertThresholds are percentages of the active cap that trigger warning emails (default 50/80/100).
get.summary: Get spending cap for the org in context

put.description: Sets or updates the org's monthly spending cap. Either or both of hardCapCents and softCapCents may be provided. alertThresholds is an array of percentages (0..100); when omitted defaults to [50, 80, 100]. Setting hardCapCents to null removes the hard cap.

get.description: Returns every credit grant ever issued to the authenticated org, newest first, with computed used / remaining / status (active|exhausted|expired). USD cents throughout — frontend formats to the customer's display currency.
get.summary: List credits for the org in context

get.description: Gets billing estimate for the organization in context

Returns one row per billable metric (anything with at least one row in pricing_tiers) showing the free-tier ceiling, the org's current month-to-date units, and the projected end-of-month figure. Storage metrics use the MTD average as the projection (already a rate); usage metrics use linear extrapolation. Frontend uses overflowProjected to flag metrics on track to incur charges.
get.summary: Free-tier usage status for the org in context

get.description: Lists invoices for the organization in context
Gets the PDF of a specific invoice
Returns active payment methods stored against the organization's Stripe Customer. Replaced/dead methods are excluded.

post.description: Creates a Stripe SetupIntent that the frontend uses with Stripe Elements to collect a card with full SCA authentication. The resulting PaymentMethod is attached to the org's Stripe Customer. Call POST /billing/payment-methods/{id}/default afterwards to set it as the default.
post.summary: Create a SetupIntent for adding a payment method

delete.description: Detaches the payment method in Stripe and marks the local copy as replaced. If the removed method was the default, the org has no default until a new one is set.

post.description: Marks the given payment method as the organization's default off-session charge target. The payment method must already be attached to the org's Stripe Customer (via SetupIntent).

get.description: Gets billing preferences for the organization in context

put.description: Updates billing preferences for the organization in context

get.description: Returns the rendered PDF for a Payment Request (proforma) document. The customer must belong to the org that owns the proforma.

post.description: Creates a fresh on-session PaymentIntent against the org's default payment method for the given invoice. The frontend confirms it with Stripe Elements (`stripe.confirmCardPayment(clientSecret)`), which triggers the 3DS challenge inline. On success the webhook updates the charge_attempts row and marks the invoice paid. Used by the dunning email link for SCA-failed off-session charges.
post.summary: Create an on-session PaymentIntent for SCA re-authentication

get.description: Returns every active service with its billing mode, the organization's current subscription on it (plans-mode services lazily auto-assign their default $0 plan here), and the public plan selector — presentation metadata, included quotas with metric names/units, and per-metric overage unit prices. Drives the customer Plans page with zero service-specific frontend logic.
get.summary: List billable services with plans and the org's subscriptions

get.description: Returns the org's dunning state (active / grace / blocked) + grace expiry timestamp when applicable. Used by the frontend billing banner to surface payment issues. Always returns "active" for orgs that have never been dunned.

delete.description: Cancels the organization's subscription on the given service immediately and deletes its plan entitlements (limits defaults apply again). Only allowed on choice-mode services — plans-mode organizations always hold a plan, so cancellation there returns 409 SUBSCRIPTION_CANCEL_NOT_ALLOWED (pick a different plan instead).
delete.summary: Cancel the organization's subscription (back to pay-as-you-go)

get.description: Returns the organization's current active/paused subscription on the given service (default "snapdb" for backward compatibility). 404 when the org has no subscription there (pure usage-metered).

put.description: Subscribes the organization to the given plan code. The target service is the PLAN's service: if the organization already has a subscription there, its plan is changed (upgrade/downgrade) mid-period; otherwise a new subscription is created. Only public plans of plans/choice-mode services are selectable (409 SERVICE_NOT_SUBSCRIBABLE for metered services, 404 for hidden plans). Entitlements sync to the limits service asynchronously.
put.summary: Subscribe to or change the organization's plan
